intro h'
apply MeasureTheory.NullSingletonClass.of_null_measurable_set
intros x hx
have : μ (Set.singleton x) = 0 := by
  have h_dirac : μ = MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac x := by
    contrapose! h'
    exact h_dirac
  rw [h_dirac]
  exact MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac_apply _
exact this
